# SAPÉ d-MCP -- Language Flag Icons Mapping
#
# This file is documentation only. Nothing in the codebase reads it: the
# single source of truth is LanguageRegistry.LANGUAGES in
# src/sape_d_mcp/language_registry.py, and flag_mapping.py derives FLAG_MAPPING
# from that registry rather than restating it here a third time. This table
# is regenerated by hand from those two modules and from what is actually on
# disk in this directory, so that a reader does not have to open three files
# to answer "which flag goes with which locale".
#
# f-MCP's own copy of this file (fixed here rather than inherited -- see
# DEVELOPMENT-PLAN.md defect 10 / .claude/skills/fmcp-reference/SKILL.md)
# described 18 SVG flags on two-letter codes, of which only Spanish and
# English actually shipped. What ships in d-MCP today is 18 PNG files keyed
# by full BCP-47 tags (`xx-XX`), one per registered locale, all present on
# disk -- see tests/test_language_resources.py, which asserts the file list
# and the PNG magic number for every one of them, and pins that this text
# file is never itself the thing anything is checked against.
#
# "Authored" below means a human wrote the GUI's translated strings for that
# locale in gui/i18n/translations.py. "Seeded" means the locale is registered
# and has a flag, but its translation table entries are the English source
# text copied verbatim, pending translation -- exactly the honesty
# DEVELOPMENT-PLAN.md's decisions table and the README already commit to:
# 18 locales registered, en-US and es-ES genuinely authored, the rest seeded.

Locale | Native name | English name        | Region           | Flag file        | Translation
-------|-------------|----------------------|------------------|-------------------|------------
en-US  | English     | English              | North America    | england.png       | Authored (source language)
es-ES  | Español     | Spanish              | Western Europe   | spain.png         | Authored
fr-FR  | Français    | French               | Western Europe   | france.png        | Seeded from English
de-DE  | Deutsch     | German               | Western Europe   | germany.png       | Seeded from English
it-IT  | Italiano    | Italian              | Western Europe   | italy.png         | Seeded from English
pt-BR  | Português   | Portuguese           | South America    | brazil.png        | Seeded from English
nl-NL  | Nederlands  | Dutch                | Western Europe   | netherlands.png   | Seeded from English
sv-SE  | Svenska     | Swedish              | Northern Europe  | sweden.png        | Seeded from English
da-DK  | Dansk       | Danish               | Northern Europe  | denmark.png       | Seeded from English
fi-FI  | Suomi       | Finnish              | Northern Europe  | finland.png       | Seeded from English
pl-PL  | Polski      | Polish               | Eastern Europe   | poland.png        | Seeded from English
cs-CZ  | Čeština     | Czech                | Eastern Europe   | czech.png         | Seeded from English
sk-SK  | Slovenčina  | Slovak               | Eastern Europe   | slovakia.png      | Seeded from English
hu-HU  | Magyar      | Hungarian            | Eastern Europe   | hungary.png       | Seeded from English
ro-RO  | Română      | Romanian             | Eastern Europe   | romania.png       | Seeded from English
ru-RU  | Русский     | Russian              | Eastern Europe   | russia.png        | Seeded from English
is-IS  | Íslenska    | Icelandic            | Northern Europe  | iceland.png       | Seeded from English
zh-CN  | 中文        | Chinese (Simplified) | Asia             | china.png         | Seeded from English

# Summary
# -------
# Registered locales : 18 (LanguageRegistry.get_language_count())
# Flag files on disk : 18 PNG, all present, all keyed by BCP-47 (see table)
# Genuinely authored : 2 -- en-US, es-ES
# Seeded from English: 16 -- registered, flagged, translatable, not yet translated
# Source format       : PNG, converted from f-MCP's SVG originals
# Legal document scope: unaffected by this table -- legal document bodies stay
#                        English-only regardless of GUI translation status
#                        (only their labels are localised); see DISCLAIMER.md.
#
# Adding a nineteenth locale means: an entry in LanguageRegistry.LANGUAGES with
# its flag_file, the PNG itself landing in this directory, translations.py
# regenerated to carry the new column, and this file updated by hand to match
# -- in that order, and this file last, because it describes the other three
# rather than the other way round.
